_about: Steam's ids for tools/package.py's SteamPipe scripts. 0 = not set yet (the scripts then hold placeholders and upload.bat refuses to run). 'platforms' is what the game is sold for on Steam (a depot is made for each; add 'macos' when there is a Mac build and a macOS depot). The full game's app and the demo's app are two apps, each with its own depots (one per system). docs/PACKAGING.md says where Steamworks shows them.
